title: Evaluating SAE Features Without Explanations as a Cheap Safety Audit

original_idea.body:
# Evaluating SAE Features Without Explanations as a Cheap Safety Audit

**Problem:** Standard SAE evaluation relies on expensive, error-prone explanations; explanation-free metrics exist but not applied as a safety-feature triage.

**Direction:** Take a public SAE, identify candidate safety features, apply explanation-free metrics to rank trustworthiness, validate against manual inspection.

**Why it matters:** Cheap training-free triage for which SAE features to trust for monitoring.

**Relevant context:** arXiv 2507.08473; SAELens/Neuronpedia.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (trustworthy feature triage aids monitoring) but a step from any deployed safety guarantee.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply existing metrics to public SAEs, no training; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused triage-ranking deliverable validated by inspection; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public SAEs, cheap triage for small labs; lab-independent.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on public SAEs; single mid GPU (some metrics analytical).

novelty.reasoning: Explanation-free metrics are proposed; applying them as a safety-feature triage may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The metrics exist; the safety-feature triage application may be open.
